subject: Request to Release Held Balance & VAT Clarification for Q2 Usage
messages:
From: Oliver Larson <oliver@larson.co>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>; priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Held balance on Q2 invoices — request to release and VAT docs attached

Hi Maya / Redwood team,

We ran into a hold on the outstanding remittance for our Q2 bill (invoices included). Our bank flagged the retention for VAT documentation until the tax team confirms the EU reverse-charge treatment. We've attached the invoice bundle and the AP remittance stub. Can you confirm what Redwood needs to both (a) clear the held balance and (b) apply any service/usage credits you discussed previously?

We appreciate a quick turnaround — the funds are sitting on our side and the merchant is asking for an ETA.

Attachments: Larson_Q2_invoices.zip (3 PDFs), remittance_stubs.pdf

Thanks,
Oliver Larson
Head of Finance
Larson Analytics
ap@larson.co
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Larson <oliver@larson.co>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Held balance on Q2 invoices — request to release and VAT docs attached

Hi Oliver — thanks for the docs. Looping in Ben from Billing to validate the invoices and Priyom from Accounts to advise on VAT handling.

Ben, quick summary: Larson has a ~€12.5k held balance tied to invoice #LAR-2027-0610. External AP has provided a VAT certificate but marked the transfer as "reverse charge" on their side. Can Billing confirm whether we can: (1) apply the previously discussed goodwill offset to clear the customer's shortfall, and (2) release the remittance if we receive the VAT certificate and sign-off?

Action: Ben — please confirm required accounting artifacts and whether a partial release is feasible this week. Priyom — please advise if the VAT certificate we received suffices for EU tax team.

Cheers,
Maya Srinivasan
Finance Business Partner, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Oliver Larson <oliver@larson.co>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 14:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Held balance on Q2 invoices — request to release and VAT docs attached

Maya / Oliver — I reviewed the invoices and the ledger. Notes: 
- Invoice LAR-2027-0610 shows usage overage that was triggered by an unexpected ingestion spike. Per our customer goodwill framework, we can authorize a one-time service credit of €12,500 as a courtesy to preserve the relationship.
- Accounting requires a valid VAT certificate (company VAT number on file) and the AP remittance stub showing the original transfer attempt before we can release funds held by our bank.
- I attached an internal reconciliation sheet (internal_recon_Q2.xlsx) with the suggested credit application lines and the GL impact.

Proposed next steps:
1) Oliver confirms VAT certificate and returns any missing AP references.
2) Once Priyom confirms the VAT doc, I will submit a collections release ticket and code the goodwill credit against LAR-2027-0610 (expected ledger update within 48 hours).

If Larson wants a faster partial release, we can do a 50% release immediately on receipt of the VAT certificate and remittance stub; remainder releases on final reconciliation.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: internal_recon_Q2.xlsx
From: Oliver Larson <oliver@larson.co>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: ap@larson.co
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:57:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Held balance on Q2 invoices — request to release and VAT docs attached

Ben / Maya — thanks for the quick review. Attached is the signed VAT certificate for Larson Analytics (vat_certificate_2027.pdf) and the AP remittance stub showing the failed transfer attempt. We accept the one-time goodwill credit of €12,500 and would prefer the 50% immediate release option while you finalize internal coding.

Please confirm the expected timing for the partial release and any next steps on our side.

Best,
Oliver

Attachments: vat_certificate_2027.pdf, remittance_stubs.pdf
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Oliver Larson <oliver@larson.co>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Held balance on Q2 invoices — request to release and VAT docs attached

Ben — please proceed with the proposed 50% immediate release upon today’s VAT certificate receipt. Capture the goodwill credit of €12,500 against LAR-2027-0610 and update the ledger. Route the release through Collections ticket BILL-912 and note the HubSpot company record (linked). Priyom — treat this as confirmed for reverse-charge; please attach the VAT cert to the Journal Entry.

Oliver — we'll process the partial release today and share the remittance confirmation once the collections payment is pushed. Expect the remaining balance release after reconciliation (target EOD 2027-07-21).

Thanks everyone — good outcome.

Maya Srinivasan
Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference
